_comment: W2b image-ingest manifest for the Unofficial Baldur's Gate 3+ Universe Seed. Lead images for key characters and locations are fetched from bg3.wiki (CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 dual-licensed, non-commercial fan use) and written ONLY to the gitignored content/worlds/_private/baldurs-gate/images/<scope>/ path. NEVER committed. Each image gets a .provenance.json sidecar with source_url, license, and attribution. To run a full ingest: python3 tools/ingest/wiki_images.py (uses this manifest). Use --max N to cap images per source during testing.

sources._comment: bg3.wiki — standalone MediaWiki (API at /w/api.php). Images are dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. See https://bg3.wiki/wiki/bg3wiki:Copyrights. Non-commercial fan project; we attribute per wiki policy.
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (dual; see https://bg3.wiki/wiki/bg3wiki:Copyrights — older revisions CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 only). Non-commercial fan use.
sources.attribution: Image from bg3.wiki, dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Unofficial, non-commercial fan content. Subject to Larian Studios' and Wizards of the Coast's Fan Content Policies.
sources._images_comment: Order: portraits (companions + key NPCs) first, then scenes (area pages with still environment leads), then item icons (legendary/notable weapons & armour whose lead image is the item icon). scene:baldurs-gate was retitled from 'Baldur's Gate' (lead resolved to a .webm video) to 'Lower City' (panoramic cityscape still). MAP-SCENE ALIGNMENT (the W2 seam): the viewer requests a scene by the raw engine location id (screen-map.jsx: scope={loc.id}); viewer/server.py _scope_key strips the leading 'loc'/'scene' token, so a manifest scene resolves a top-level location ONLY when their slugs match after that strip. All 7 baldurs-gate top-level locations are now covered: loc-lower-city→scene:lower-city, loc-upper-city→scene:upper-city, loc-outer-city→scene:outer-city (Rivington — no 'Outer City' page exists), loc-wyrms-crossing→scene:wyrms-crossing, loc-elturel→scene:elturel, loc-reithwin→scene:reithwin (Reithwin Town), loc-candlekeep→scene:candlekeep. The other scenes (elfsong-tavern, moonrise-towers, last-light-inn, sorcerous-sundries, high-hall, rivington, emerald-grove, wyrms-rock) are named-landmark art for dialogue/table backdrops (imageScope/locationScope), NOT top-level map locations — they intentionally do NOT key to a loc-* id. PORTRAIT FIX: portrait:lazel → portrait:lae-zel so it matches the engine id npc-lae-zel (_scope_key 'lae-zel'); the old 'lazel' slug normalized to 'lazel' and never resolved. scene:candlekeep still carries a _flag: Candlekeep does not appear in BG3, so the bg3.wiki lead is a tiny character-portrait icon, not a location still — it is the #1 GENERATION GAP (a Forgotten Realms Wiki / Fandom source could supply a real fortress-library still, but Fandom blocks our fetcher; see IMAGE_COVERAGE.md). npc-claudan (Claudan the Chronicler) is an ORIGINAL ClawDnD character with no wiki page → GENERATION GAP. Item list is a curated sample; see ITEM_ICONS_PLAN.md for scaling to the full catalog.

images.title: Candlekeep
images._flag: lead image is wrong — needs explicit file. Candlekeep does not appear in BG3; the bg3.wiki page's lead is a 70px character-portrait icon, not a location still. No in-game Candlekeep scene exists on the wiki.

images.title: Upper City
images._aligns_to: loc-upper-city — top-level map location. bg3.wiki lead is Upper_City_Invasion.webp, a wide in-game cityscape still (the Upper City during the Illithid invasion). WebFetch-verified 2026-05-27.

images.title: Rivington
images._aligns_to: loc-outer-city ('The Outer City & Rivington') — top-level map location. bg3.wiki has NO 'Outer City' page (404); the region's lead landmark IS Rivington (world.json: 'Rivington's circus-grounds and shrines'). Lead Rivington.jpg is a real top-view environment still. WebFetch-verified 2026-05-27.

images.title: Elturel
images._aligns_to: loc-elturel — top-level map location. bg3.wiki lead is The_Descent_of_Elturel.png, a real environment still of the city being drawn into Avernus. WebFetch-verified 2026-05-27.

images.title: Reithwin Town
images._aligns_to: loc-reithwin ('Reithwin & the Lifting Shadow') — top-level map location. Page 'Reithwin Town' lead is Reithwin_Town.webp, the town-square environment still (chosen over the 'Shadow-Cursed Lands' page whose lead is a top-down terrain map). The existing scene:moonrise-towers + scene:last-light-inn are sub-areas of this region and key differently — they do NOT resolve loc-reithwin; this entry does. WebFetch-verified 2026-05-27.
